newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil stevedores announce 48-hr national strike.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stevedores announce 48-hr national strike.

text.p: Brazilian stevedores will go on national strike in sympathy with their colleagues at Santos port at midnight Thursday (0300 GMT Friday) for 48 hours, a union official said.
"There will be a national strike on Friday," said an official at the Santos Stevedores' Union following a meeting with stevedore delegates from other ports.

Stevedores at Santos began an indefinite strike at 0700 local in protest against steel firm Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) using its own workers to load and unload vessels at its private terminal at the port.
The national strike represented the second nationwide stoppage in two weeks.

A national strike 12 days ago halted operations at several Brazilian ports, including the key coffee ports of Vitoria and Rio de Janeiro, but the most important grain loading port, Paranagua, was virtually unaffected.
